statement: AMD non-GAAP gross margin was 55 percent in Q1 2026 (GAAP 53 percent) and the company guided Q2 2026 non-GAAP gross margin to approximately 56 percent.
why: Gross margin holding up while data center revenue grows fast suggests AMD is not buying share with price, which is a sign that accelerator demand still exceeds available supply.

impact.mechanism: Margin guided higher alongside revenue growth indicates pricing power rather than discounting, consistent with demand running ahead of supply.

evidence.excerpt: GAAP gross margin was 53%; non-GAAP gross margin was 55%.
Non-GAAP gross margin is expected to be approximately 56%.

confidence.basis: Primary source: AMD official earnings release for both the actual and the guided margin.

dispersion: Value recorded is the non-GAAP figure; GAAP gross margin was 53 percent.
